items.information:

Please note there is strict density limit at the hall to comply with COVID density restrictions.  There is a limit of ONE guest per competitor.

**If you feel sick, stay at home.** If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will **not** be permitted in the venue.  We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

items.name: Marrickville Autumn Saturday 2021
items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
**Important Note:**
This competition is a twin competition alongside [Marrickville Autumn Sunday 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleAutumnSunday2021). Competitors are permitted to attend **ONLY ONE of these competitions**. More information can be found on the Information tab.

Please also read the Information tab carefully to make sure you understand the COVID-safe requirements. Guests are limited to strictly one per competitor.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
